push.title: L 1-4 vs aztecuba | You: 7.4
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.4 against aztecuba. Shake it off like a dog after a bath and go again.

THE GOOD
+ 2 shots at aztecuba's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (14 vs their best 13). That's what showing up looks like.
+ 4 goals conceded: +0.2. The fundamentals are your friend.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Tell you what: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. Clean it up and fly.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.4. That's the kind of number that loses matches.
- Completed passes 14, down from your usual 26. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 3 and set up a relegation match. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Habit to build: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.

Rondo time: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.

Pick one thing from that list and own it next match. Just one. - Coach Lasso
